note: Load into the Menu feature so the agent quotes exact plan prices via lookup_menu. Prices in dollars.

items.name: Starter plan
items.description: Monthly. 100 AI minutes and 100 text segments included, then 15 cents per extra minute and 3 cents per extra text segment. Everything in ViFi included.

items.name: Growth plan
items.description: Monthly, most popular. 500 AI minutes and 500 text segments included, then 12 cents per extra minute and 3 cents per extra text segment. Everything in ViFi included.

items.name: Business plan
items.description: Monthly. 2,000 AI minutes and 2,000 text segments included, then 10 cents per extra minute and 2 cents per extra text segment. Everything in ViFi included, lowest overage rates.

items.name: Free trial
items.description: Seven days, no credit card. 25 AI minutes and 50 text segments. Up to three approved phone numbers can call the agent during the trial; transfers to a person switch on when you subscribe.

items.name: Call summaries, action items, transcripts and recordings
items.description: Delivered within a minute or two of each call by email, text, Slack, Discord or HubSpot.

items.name: Knowledge base, menu and business hours
items.description: Articles, documents and web pages the agent answers from, a menu with prices, and hours for open-or-closed questions.

items.name: Integrations
items.description: HubSpot, Google Calendar, Calendly, Square, Slack, Discord, Gmail and custom webhooks.

items.name: Website widget and team access
items.description: A voice widget for your website and unlimited teammates with Admin, Member and Viewer roles.
